newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts jobless rate 3.7 pct, 8-year low.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts jobless rate 3.7 pct, 8-year low.

text.p: Massachusetts Division of Employment and Training said Friday the state's jobless rate for February dipped to 3.7 percent, its lowest level in nearly eight years.

"February's unemployment rate of 3.7 percent is 1.1 percent lower than it was last February, and at its lowest point in early eight years, when in April 1989 it was 3.6 percent," the Division's Deputy Director Nils Nordberg said in a statement.
Nordberg also said the payroll survey of Massachusetts jobs in February showed an estimated 3,074,700 jobs, 3,300 more than in January 1997 and 64,400 more than in February 1996.

"The February jobs estimate of 3,074,700 shows a growth of 289,400 jobs since the December 1991 low point and is at its highest level since September 1989," said Angelo Buonopane, director of the state's labor department.
The seasonally adjusted data shows a labor force of 3,212,500, with 3,092,200 employed Massachusetts residents and 120,300 unemployed in February.
